description: This file is a test script for a FastCGI application using asyncio. It defines a custom ApplicationRequest class and a main server loop to handle FastCGI requests, primarily testing CGI interactions.

classes.name: TestAppRequest
classes.description: A subclass of pylt.fastcgi.ApplicationRequest that handles subprocess I/O for FastCGI requests, including managing stdin, stdout, and stderr streams asynchronously.

methods.name: None received_params(self)
methods.description: Processes incoming request parameters to set up and spawn a subprocess, managing its stdout and stderr asynchronously.

methods.name: None recv_stdin(self, data: bytes)
methods.description: Handles incoming data for the subprocess via stdin, including closing stdin when data is empty.

methods.name: _handle_task_stdout(self, process: asyncio.subprocess.Process)
methods.description: Reads from subprocess stdout and writes the data back to the FastCGI response.

methods.name: _handle_task_stderr(self, process: asyncio.subprocess.Process)
methods.description: Reads from subprocess stderr and writes the data back appropriately.

methods.name: _handle_task_wait(self, process: asyncio.subprocess.Process)
methods.description: Waits for the subprocess to complete and then triggers cleanup.

methods.name: None handle_fcgi_cgi(reader: asyncio.StreamReader, writer: asyncio.StreamWriter)
methods.description: Handles incoming FastCGI connections by creating an Application instance and running it.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Sets up the server socket and starts the asyncio server to handle incoming FastCGI connections.

ctags.pattern: /^async def handle_fcgi_cgi(reader: asyncio.StreamReader, writer: asyncio.StreamWriter) -> None:$/

ctags.pattern: /^    async def recv_stdin(self, data: bytes) -> None:$/
